description: Parameters for the AQA test stage. Vendor overrides may suppress, replace, or extend these via a vendor-scripts/14-aqa-tests.params.json in the config repo.

parameterGroups.name: Stage Selections
parameterGroups.description: Boolean flags that control which pipeline stages are enabled. All stage-gate parameters are collected here so operators can see and adjust the full execution plan in one place.

parameterGroups.name: Source Control
parameterGroups.description: Refs that pin exactly what source is checked out for this stage. Leave empty to use the defaults defined in adoptium_pipeline_config.json.

parameters.name: AQA_REF
parameters.description: Git branch or tag for the aqa-tests repository. Empty = default branch defined in adoptium_pipeline_config.json.

parameters.name: BUILD_REF
parameters.description: Git branch or tag for the build-scripts repository. Empty = default defined in adoptium_pipeline_config.json.
